notes.title: Demo Version 1.2 Update!
notes.content:
Today, ahead of Next Fest, we’re unveiling a completely fresh way to slice through foes: the Bladedancer. Unlike the Steelhand, whose power grows through ever-bigger swords and axes, the Bladedancer thrives on agility and layered abilities—poisons, wounds, blinds, and deft dodges—to stay alive. Its cards are small and nimble, chaining together in rapid combos, with a touch of randomness to keep every encounter feeling unpredictable and alive. Mastering this class means thinking on your feet, improvising on the fly, and turning chance into victory.

[list]
[*][b]✨ New Playable Class: Bladedancer[/b]
[list]
 [*]Starting Deck Essentials:  
  [list]
   [*]Shivs – pierce through armor with zero cost  
   [*]Daggers – low-cost, high-precision strikes  
   [*]Claws – unleash multiple random hits for chaotic damage  
  [/list]
 [*]Advanced Arsenal & Abilities:  
  [list]
   [*]Throwing Knives – safe ranged throws to pick off foes  
   [*]Poison Daggers – inflict lingering toxic damage  
   [*]Wounding & Blinding Strikes – cripple and disorient your targets  
  [/list]
[/list]

[*][b]⚡ Ability-Driven Combos & Unpredictable Chaos[/b]  
[list]
 [*]Core Bladedancer cards cost 0–1 Energy, fueling lightning-fast chains.  
 [*]Advanced cards layer unique effects—apply poison, then blind, then finish with a random claw strike to maximize impact.  
 [*]Random targeting and “last-hit” bonuses reward creative play and keep each run feeling fresh.  
[/list]
[/list]

[center][i]Step into the dance of blades—your next legend awaits on the battlefield![/i][/center]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.2 Update!
notes.content:
Today’s patch introduces new Steelhand Hammer skills, overhauls stun resistance, adds a battle countdown that powers up enemies, accelerates early leveling, and touches up shop and thief mechanics.

[list]
[*][b]🔨 New Steelhand Hammer Skills[/b]
[list]
 [*][b]Crushing Force[/b] – Gives hammers +1 Wounds on hit, making enemies more vulnerable.  
 [*][b]Concussive Blow[/b] – Gives hammers +2 power against stun resistance, synergizing with the new Stun Resist system (see below)  
[/list]

[*][b]⛏️ Hammer Stun Adjustment[/b]
[list]
 [*]Removed infinite-stun exploit: enemies now gain permanent Stun Resistance equal to times stunned (e.g., 2 stuns → 2 resistance).  
 [*]Stun Resistance blocks the next stun hit, then decreases by 1—consecutive stunning is thus still possible but requires more power each time.  
[/list]

[*][b]⏳ Tension & Urgency![/b]
[list]
 [*]Enemies now power up as time goes on: new area countdown starts at 5 battles.  
 [*]After 5 battles, non-boss enemies gain HP & damage multipliers: 1.25 → 1.5 → 2.0 → 2.5 → 3 → 4 → 5…  
 [*]Boss fights remain fixed difficulty—pick your paths and pace your progress carefully!  
[/list]

[*][b]⭐ EXP Levels Reduced[/b]  
Faster Level 1→2 progression means you can grab two items sooner and craft more interesting early builds.

[*][b]♣️ Shop Improvements[/b]
[list]
 [*]Remove multiple cards in one visit—removal cost increases by 5 each time (5 → 10 → 15…).  
 [*]Card prices update dynamically: too-costly cards get a red price tag when removals push you over budget.  
[/list]

[*][b]💰 Thief Gold Tracker[/b]  
Thieves now display stolen gold amount—know exactly what’s on the line when you hunt them down!

[*][b]⚙️ Minor Tweaks & QoL[/b]
[list]
 [*]Card prices now refresh in the shop immediately after a removal.  
[/list]

[*][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
 [*]Fixed thorns interactions: thieves killed by your thorns now return the correct stolen gold.  
[/list]
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback—we’re hammering away at more improvements! Stay vigilant! 🗡️

[center][i]Happy stabbing![/i][/center]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Today’s patch focuses on fresh build possibilities, clearer visuals, and quality-of-life polish. Read on, sharpen those blades, and dive back in!

[list]
[*][b]🛡️ New Steelhand Skills[/b]
Forge even sturdier builds with two defensive skill options:
 [list]
 [*][b]Stonewall[/b] – +1 Damage Reduction whenever you have Armor
 [*][b]Armor Up[/b] – Each unspent Energy at turn end converts to [b]3[/b] Armor
 [/list]

[*][b]💰 Coin Theft Goes Animated[/b]
 [list]
 [*]When a Thief nicks your gold, coins now burst out of your hero 🌟
 [*]Take the thief down before it escapes and watch those coins zip back!
 [/list]

[*][b]⚙️ Minor Tweaks & QoL[/b]
 [list]
 [*]Deck-trimming just got affordable: removal cost slashed from [b]20 → 5[/b]
 [*]Language choice now sticks between runs (saved to config)
 [*]Filled in a batch of missing translations (more on the way)
 [*]Capped victory-screen gold pile so XP has room to shine
 [*]Tooltip glow-up: more icons and clearer text for Slow, Wounds, Poison, etc.
 [/list]

[*][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b]
 [list]
 [*]Large Axe now correctly grants +2 damage to full-health targets (was +1)
 [/list]
[/list]

I’m keeping an eye on your runs and will keep iterating. Thanks for the relentless feedback—together we’re slicing this roguelike into razor-sharp form! 🗡️

[center][i]Happy stabbing![/i][/center]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
A massive thank-you to everyone who’s been diving into Deck of Stabs! Your feedback has been incredible, and today’s patch brings a brand-new weapon, balance boosts, QoL goodies, and pesky bug fixes:

[list]
[*][b]🔨 New Weapon: Maul Hammer[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579247/265e8fd9aa153cd8c9273a94784281b143bcc580.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]A 2/5 Common Hammer, making it the most powerful common hammer, however, after using it your next attack costs +1 Energy
[*]Use it wisely!
[/list]

[*][b]⚔️ Skill Buffs[/b]  
[b]Hearty[/b] is by far the most popular skill pick at Level 3 (who doesn't want more Energy?!). But I do want all the skills to be viable options.

So I'm experimenting with giving [b]Axeman[/b] and [b]Swordmaster[/b] a small buff to make them more viable. This buff may get reverted if this ends up being too much power, but in the meantime, they should pack some extra punch!

Also, more skills are planned for future updates!

[list]
[*][b]Axeman[/b] From +1 → +2 damage to all Axes  
[*][b]Swordmaster[/b] From +2 → +3 damage to all Swords  
[/list]

[*][b]🗡️ Weapon Buff: Broad Sword[/b]
Previously, the [b]Broad Sword[/b] was just a worse version of the [b]Long Sword[/b]. However, to make things more interesting it's gotten a buff to make it more competitive and perhaps better than the [b]Long Sword[/b] in certain circumstances.

Hence, it's still a 1/3 weapon, but now deals +2 damage vs. Stunned enemies.

[*][b]🐺 Enemy & Encounter Tuning[/b]  
As always, I'm watching enemy encounter statistics to look for enemies that may be unduly powerful. Here are a few tweaks as a result of recent playtesting.

[list]
[*]Rat Wolves no longer inflict Wounds but have higher Health & Damage  
[*]Vicious Rat Wolves still wound, but damage down 6→5  
[*]Level 3 Blue Thief fight eased: now 2 Thieves + 2 Bandits
[/list]

[*][b]☁️ Cloud Saves Incoming[/b]  
Gameplay saves aren't ready just yet but I'm laying the groundwork. Volume settings should now persist via Steam cloud saving. Full progress saving arriving soon!

[*][b]📍 Map Legend Added[/b]  
Realized this would be helpful for new players, was easy to add.

[*][b]✨ Minor Tweaks[/b]  
Added a handful of other minor improvements. For instance, weapon and item cards now have a subtle background behind their main graphic (more art polish next updates), shopkeeper bubbles jiggle on click for clearer feedback, and updated Rat Wolf sprites

[*][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b]  
[list]
[*]Temporary effects no longer last past end of turn  
[*]Shop tooltips fixed to behave correctly  
[*]Damage that killed off armor was being counted twice, fixed
[*]Cards stolen by Red Thief weren't being recovered if the Red Thief was the last enemy to die, fixed
[*]Victory screen had a minor de-sync if the final kill was a poison kill, fixed
[/list][/list]

I’ll keep a close eye on play metrics and roll out more tweaks as needed. Thanks again for all your support—you’re making Deck of Stabs sharper than ever! 🗡️

[center][i]Happy stabbing![/i][/center]

notes.title: First Demo Patch Now Live!
notes.content:
A huge thank-you to everyone who’s jumped into the [b]Deck of Stabs [/b]demo over the weekend. Your feedback and play metrics have been invaluable—and today I’m excited to ship a small patch that makes some quality-of-life improvements:

🛠 What’s in this update?

[b]Early Encounter Rebalance[/b]
[list]
[*] The first few fights are now more forgiving, giving you extra breathing room to learn your cards and build your deck before the heat ramps up
[*] Enemy numbers and types have been slightly tuned down in the opening few fights
[/list]

[b]Minor Tweaks and Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Price tags in shops now shown in red for items you can't afford
[*] Fixed a minor issue related to tooltips sometimes disappearing
[/list]

I’ll continue monitoring play patterns closely and may roll out further tweaks if needed. Your early support means the world—thank you for diving in and giving this game a try! I'll be working in the next few weeks to make [b]Deck of Stabs[/b] the best stab-fest it can be. 🗡️

Happy stabbing!
